# Router Reporter Generated by Dev'Hunter Security
# RouterOS v7.21.4 compatible (template)

:local botToken "{isi token bot}"
:local chatId "{isi chat id}"
:local ifaceA "{sesuaikan dengan nama interface WAN}"

:local rxA [/interface get [find where name=$ifaceA] rx-byte]
:local txA [/interface get [find where name=$ifaceA] tx-byte]

:local rxMBA ($rxA / 1024 / 1024)
:local txMBA ($txA / 1024 / 1024)

:local sysName [/system identity get name]
:local model [/system resource get board-name]
:local uptime [/system resource get uptime]
:local version [/system resource get version]
:local cpuLoad [/system resource get cpu-load]

:local hotspot [/ip hotspot active print count-only]
:local activePPPoE [/ppp active print count-only]
:local totalPPPoE [/ppp secret print count-only]
:local inactivePPPoE ($totalPPPoE - $activePPPoE)

:local FreeMemory ([/system resource get free-memory] / 1024 / 1024)
:local TotalMemory ([/system resource get total-memory] / 1024 / 1024)
:local FreeHdd ([/system resource get free-hdd-space] / 1024 / 1024)
:local TotalHdd ([/system resource get total-hdd-space] / 1024 / 1024)
:local BadBlock [/system resource get bad-block]

:local inactiveList ""
:local count 0

:foreach i in=[/ppp secret find] do={
    :if ($count >= 10) do={ :break }
    :local user [/ppp secret get $i name]
    :if ([:len [/ppp active find where name=$user]] = 0) do={
        :set inactiveList ($inactiveList."\F0\9F\94\B4 ".$user."%0A")
        :set count ($count+1)
    }
}

:if ($count = 0) do={ :set inactiveList "Tidak ada user%0A" }

:local isolirList ""
:local isolirCount 0

:foreach i in=[/ppp secret find] do={
    :if ([/ppp secret get $i profile]="ISOLIR") do={
        :set isolirList ($isolirList."\F0\9F\9A\AB ".[/ppp secret get $i name]."%0A")
        :set isolirCount ($isolirCount+1)
    }
}

:if ($isolirCount=0) do={ :set isolirList "Tidak ada user%0A" }

:local msg ""
:set msg ($msg."\F0\9F\93\88 Router Report%0A=================%0A")
:set msg ($msg."\F0\9F\86\94 Router: ".$sysName."%0A")
:set msg ($msg."\F0\9F\92\BB Model: ".$model."%0A")
:set msg ($msg."\F0\9F\92\AC Version: ".$version."%0A")
:set msg ($msg."\F0\9F\95\94 Uptime: ".$uptime."%0A")
:set msg ($msg."\F0\9F\9A\A6 CPU Load: ".$cpuLoad."%25%0A")
:set msg ($msg."\F0\9F\9A\A5 Free Memory: ".$FreeMemory." MiB%0A")
:set msg ($msg."\F0\9F\9A\A5 Total Memory: ".$TotalMemory." MiB%0A")
:set msg ($msg."\F0\9F\93\A6 Free HDD: ".$FreeHdd." MiB%0A")
:set msg ($msg."\F0\9F\93\A6 Total HDD: ".$TotalHdd." MiB%0A")
:set msg ($msg."\F0\9F\90\9E Bad Block: ".$BadBlock."%0A")
:set msg ($msg."\F0\9F\91\A4 Hotspot User: ".$hotspot."%0A")
:set msg ($msg."\F0\9F\91\A4 PPPoE Summary:%0ATotal: ".$totalPPPoE."%0AActive: ".$activePPPoE."%0AInactive: ".$inactivePPPoE."%0AIsolir: ".$isolirCount."%0A")
:set msg ($msg."%0A\F0\9F\93\8B Inactive User List:%0A".$inactiveList)
:set msg ($msg."%0A\F0\9F\9A\AB User Isolir:%0A".$isolirList)
:set msg ($msg."%0A\F0\9F\93\89 Interface: ".$ifaceA." RX: ".$rxMBA." MiB - TX: ".$txMBA." MiB")

:local url ("https://api.telegram.org/bot".$botToken."/sendMessage")
:local data ("chat_id=".$chatId."&text=".$msg)

/tool fetch url=$url http-method=post http-header-field="Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" http-data=$data output=none as-value
